title: Unique local determinant functional for a fixed tuple
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], M an O_X-module sheaf, n a natural number, U an open and φ_j sections of its internal dual [def-pur-sheaf-hom] over U. There is a unique internal dual section q of the sheafified exterior power [def-sc-sheaf-exterior-power] over U such that, for every subopen g:V→U and tuple a_i in M(V), q_V(a_1∧⋯∧a_n)=det(φ_j,V(a_i)). No freeness hypothesis is imposed.

source.place: Tags 03CY and 0BRT (determinant inversion); pairingDual and pairingDual_ιMulti_ιMulti. Expanded local argument written by N1; Stacks pages read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/03CY and https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0BRT.

proof.text: Evaluate each dual section on every subopen V of U. The canonical ring exterior-power pairing gives the linear functional on the exterior power of M(V) with the determinant formula.

The functionals commute with restriction: on pure wedges this is the naturality of the given dual sections and preservation of determinants by ring maps; the spanning property extends this identity to all sections. They form a presheaf morphism on Over U.

Restrict the exterior sheafification unit to Over U. The unit is locally bijective, and open restriction preserves local bijectivity. Its target is the restriction of exteriorSheaf M n. Maps from its source into the restricted structure sheaf therefore extend uniquely across it by module sheafification. The extension is q. The formula follows by precomposition with the unit; pure wedges span before sheafification, giving uniqueness. Empty tuples and zero rings use the same construction.

lean.statement:
theorem exterior_dual_pairing_functional (X : Scheme.{u}) (M : X.Modules) (n : ℕ)
    (U : X.Opens) (φ : Fin n → (Scheme.Modules.dual M).val.obj (op U)) :
    ∃! q : (Scheme.Modules.dual (Scheme.Modules.exteriorSheaf M n)).val.obj (op U),
      ∀ (V : X.Opens) (g : V ⟶ U) (a : Fin n → M.val.obj (op V)),
        q.app (op (Over.mk g)) (Scheme.Modules.exteriorSheafSection M n V a) =
          (Matrix.of fun i j ↦ (show X.presheaf.obj (op V) from
            (φ j).app (op (Over.mk g)) (a i))).det
